title: NO THOUGHT FOR TOMORROW
BEDTIME PRAYER
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day
stock_queries: soft candle glow dark room night
quiet pine forest foggy night sky
gentle ocean waves under starlight night
misty mountain valley at twilight blue hour
cozy window dusk warm light rain
peaceful starry sky over calm water

scenes.a: If you are replaying tomorrow's hardest conversation in the dark, put it down right now.
Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself.
Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
Heavenly Father, we hand over every unseen sunrise, every unwritten hour, and every unknown outcome into your loving care.
Release our hands from trying to carry what is not yet born, and quiet our weary minds.
Rest over this bed, steady every anxious thought, and grant a deep, restoring night of sleep.
Subscribe to rest in God's peace every night.
